After water quenching, a specimen was studied by scanning electron microscopy (SEM) and analyzed by energy dispersive spectroscopy (EDS) to observe the intermetallic compounds and dross precipitation in the solidifed Zn phase enriched with Cr.

Using a selective Zn evaporation method [1997Reu], these different dross specimens were obtained as crystals separated from the Zn phase and were studied by thermal analysis (differential scanning calorimetry, DSC).
X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS) analysis was carried out on the solidified Zn to confirm the determination of the composition of the liquid phase obtained previously by EDS analysis.
